name: How long does it take to complete a garage storage installation?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to complete a garage storage installation?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a garage storage installation depends on the project's complexity and the specific solutions being installed. Simple installations, such as a few wall shelves or overhead racks, can often be completed within one to two days. More extensive projects involving custom cabinetry, slatwall systems across multiple walls, or integrated workbenches might take anywhere from three days to a week. Larger, multi-faceted projects requiring significant demolition or custom fabrication could extend beyond a week. The contractor will provide a clear timeline during the planning phase.
acceptedAnswer.description: Simple installations take 1-2 days, while extensive custom projects can range from 3 days to over a week, depending on complexity.
